description: This file defines the public API for retained memory drivers in the Zephyr project, including function types, driver API structure, and syscall wrappers for size, read, write, and clear operations.
external_methods: int retained_mem_read(const struct device *dev, off_t offset, uint8_t *buffer, size_t size)
int retained_mem_write(const struct device *dev, off_t offset, const uint8_t *buffer, size_t size)

methods.name: retained_mem_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the retained memory area for a device.

methods.name: retained_mem_read
methods.description: Reads data from the retained memory area of a device.

methods.name: retained_mem_write
methods.description: Writes data to the retained memory area of a device.

methods.name: retained_mem_clear
methods.description: Clears the retained memory area by setting it to zero.
